notes.title: Norega
notes.notes:
My new game Norega is coming up... It feels like my previous games , but has better art. has also better mechanics.

I worked really hard on this game! I really hope you can like it as much as I liked making it!

Norega is a game where you play as Kurt, a Knight in training, and your task is to feed up Kurt's stats so that he can improve in Strength and be able to defeat the tougher monsters found on the outskirts of Norega.

notes.title: Fixed hughe BUG!
notes.notes:
There was a bug that was causing enemies to increase in strenght every time you visited the boss Room!

This will no longer happen!

Sorry! =)

notes.title: Free to Play - Mission IDLE!
notes.notes:
This game will become free to play soon!

I have intentions in making some of my games FTP in the near future while I am working on BIG paid projects!

notes.title: Some adjustments!
notes.notes:
Game will no longer run if you are not on the Battle Screen. If you are on Menu Screen nothing will be calculated. I also fixed some bugs when trying to buy multiple Crits with TP. 

Have fun!

notes.title: OFFLINE PROGRESS(FIXED CRASH)
notes.notes:
The game wont crash anymore when runing on background!
The game now runs offline as well!

There is a loading time everytime you load the game because the game is calculating how much you earn this shouldnt take too long tough.


I hope you like these changes I plan on applying this to every game!

Thank you so much =)!
